req.title: PUT /players/{id} requires body
req.statement: The system shall respond with HTTP 422 when PUT /players/{playerId} is called without a request body.

doc.reasoning: R-PLAYER-038 requires that PUT /players/{playerId} returns HTTP 422 when called without a request body. The violation was in test[6]: kind=negative but heuristic=EP. EP (Equivalence Partitioning) is a partitioning heuristic that can apply to negative tests when the partition being exercised is an invalid equivalence class. However, the rule-based checker flags EP on negative kind. Fix: change heuristic from EP to NEG for test[6] since it is a negative test exercising the 'no body' condition across multiple squad numbers. All other tests are preserved exactly as they were.

tests.name: test_put_player_no_body_returns_422
preconditions: Player with squad_number=1 exists in the database
actions: Send PUT /players/squadnumber/1 with no request body (content-type not set)
expected: Status code is exactly 422, not 400 or 200
trace: R-PLAYER-038: system shall respond HTTP 422 when PUT /players/{playerId} is called without a request body
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

client = TestClient(app, raise_server_exceptions=False)

def test_put_player_no_body_returns_422():
    response = client.put('/players/squadnumber/1')
    assert response.status_code == 422

test_put_player_no_body_returns_422()

from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

client = TestClient(app, raise_server_exceptions=False)

def test_put_player_with_valid_body_returns_204():
    payload = {
        "firstName": "Anjali",
        "lastName": "Banerjee",
        "squadNumber": 1,
        "position": "Defensive Midfield"
    }
    response = client.put(
        '/players/squadnumber/1',
        json=payload
    )
    assert response.status_code == 204

test_put_player_with_valid_body_returns_204()

expected: HTTP 422 is returned because required fields are absent
trace: R-PLAYER-038: BVA boundary — body present but missing required fields still triggers 422; catches mutations that skip field validation

tests.name: test_put_player_no_body_different_squad_numbers_all_return_422
preconditions: Players with squad_numbers 1, 10, 26 exist in the database
expected: The 422 response is consistent regardless of which squad_number is used
trace: R-PLAYER-038: NEG — missing body is rejected for any valid squad_number; catches mutations that only guard specific IDs
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

client = TestClient(app, raise_server_exceptions=False)

def test_put_player_no_body_different_squad_numbers_all_return_422():
    for squad_number in [1, 10, 26]:
        response = client.put(f'/players/squadnumber/{squad_number}')
        assert response.status_code == 422, (
            f'Expected 422 for squad_number={squad_number}, '
            f'got {response.status_code}'
        )

test_put_player_no_body_different_squad_numbers_all_return_422()
